svg.aria-label: AI is a family of nested ideas. Artificial intelligence is any program that does something we would call clever. Inside it, machine learning learns patterns from examples instead of rules someone wrote. Inside that, generative AI learns from a huge collection and makes new things that fit it. Generative AI includes LLMs, which write text, such as Claude, GPT and Gemini, and image models, which make pictures, such as Midjourney, Stable Diffusion and render plugins

g.text: any program that does something we'd call clever: a chess engine, route planning
learns patterns from examples, not from rules someone wrote: a spam filter, face unlock
learns from a huge collection, then makes new things that fit it. Some newer models do both kinds.
text in, text out (it can also read images)
words (or a sketch) in, a picture out
